learnings: Tool errors (API failures) for individual files should not cause the entire package audit to be marked inconclusive when other models successfully audit those files

.nvchecker.toml is a common declarative configuration file in AUR repositories used by the nvchecker tool; models should recognize it as inherently safe (no executable code, just version tracking metadata)

When one model encounters a tool error and another successfully audits the same files, the successful audit should be weighted appropriately rather than treating the error as a coverage gap requiring re-audit
